name: Chekhov’s Gun
axiom: Plant the detail early that will decide the end, and do not point at it.
trigger: Strategy narratives and technical differentiators foreshadowed before they matter.

steps.text: Place the detail where it looks incidental.
Leave it unremarked for most of the piece.
Let it decide the outcome, and name it only then.

antiPattern.violation: Planting a detail and then explaining it, which turns foreshadowing into a footnote and removes the payoff.
antiPattern.remediation: Trust the return. If the reader must be reminded, the plant was too quiet or too late.
